sweep Aug4: AP (Aug 4) reports that the spill has grown to about 150 km2 (Greenpeace, Aug 3), 'reaching shorelines and far out to sea' and covering large parts of Qibliyah Island off Dhofar. Reuters (Jul 31) warns that monsoon weather could spread it to coastal areas. Oman's Dhofar or Al Wusta mainland is the only realistic landfall, since the SW monsoon pushes oil northeast; mainland contamination is not yet confirmed.

sweep Aug4: The group stage is nearly done. Morocco won Group A (7 pts, 0 conceded) and meets B2 South Africa; Ivory Coast won Group B and meets A2 Algeria (CAF/ESPN, Aug 4). Group C has Malawi on 6 (beat Nigeria 3-2), so Nigeria can at best finish C2 and face D1 Cameroon. Under CAF's usual bracket (AFCON 2013-17, CHAN 2024: SF1 = W(A1-B2) v W(D1-C2)), Nigeria would meet Morocco in the semi, so 'Morocco, Nigeria' is now unlikely and the mass is spread across cross-half pairs.
